lines.text: Many learners say: I have many homeworks today.
Better: I have a lot of homework today.
Homework has no s. Say a lot of.
Homework! I have a lot of homework.

data.right: I have a lot of homework today.
data.why: Homework has no s. Say a lot of.

en.tip: Homework is uncountable, so no s and no many. Say “a lot of homework”
en.caption: Do you say “I have many homeworks today”? 😅 Homework is uncountable in English, so it takes no s and no many. Say “I have a lot of homework today”! Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
